About us

We help people find remote work faster

SeekRemoteJobs aggregates verified remote job listings from hundreds of company career pages — free, daily, and without requiring a sign-up.

Our story

Why we built SeekRemoteJobs

Finding a legitimate remote job is harder than it should be. Most job boards are cluttered with stale listings, duplicate postings, and positions that were never truly remote to begin with. Recruiters gate the best roles behind sign-up walls, and aggregators charge employers to appear at the top, distorting what you see.

We built SeekRemoteJobs to be different: a fast, focused tool that goes directly to the source. Our crawlers visit the official careers pages of vetted companies every day and surface only their current open roles. No employer payments for placement. No user accounts required. No monetisation of your personal data. Just a clean interface between you and the companies that are actually hiring.

Remote work has transformed how knowledge workers live and build careers. We believe the infrastructure for finding remote jobs should be equally open and transparent — and that's what we're building.

What we stand for

Our values

Every listing links directly to the employer. No aggregation fees, no mystery sources, no paid placement.

⚡

Under the hood

How SeekRemoteJobs works

01

We identify verified company career pages

Our team manually vets each company and career page source before adding it to our crawler list. We focus on technology, software, and knowledge-work companies with established remote hiring practices.

02

Automated crawlers run every day

Daily crawl jobs visit each career page, extract current job listings, normalise the data (title, location, date, apply URL), and insert new roles into our database while removing postings that have been taken down.

03

You search, filter, and apply directly

The site gives you fast filtering by keyword, company, location, and recency. Every "Apply Now" link takes you straight to the employer's official posting — not a proxy or tracking redirect.

04

The service stays free via advertising

Non-intrusive display ads (served by Google AdSense) keep the platform free for job seekers. We do not charge companies for listings, sell your data, or accept paid placement requests.
